items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: Piku, Papa Celestan, oh we had a group back at his house.

ctx.x: I don't know, B-O-Z-E-N-E, something like that. They call it booze, that means they have a good time together. But we went by Johnny's house, and I think that was, he was figuring on going away. And we all went there sitting on, eating, drinking, playing instruments, you know, banjo, guitar, and sales and all. Sales and all, what's the size they pick up on that, sales pick up on that way he plays banjo. You know, Johnny C. Sales plays a banjo, he picks a lot of bass runs whilst he plays. He's a good musician,…
They said, I had a tape recorder down there at that time.
